title: taraxacum dens-leonis subsp. officinale
intro: Taraxacum dens-leonis subsp. officinale, commonly known as the officinal dandelion, is a subspecies of the dandelion plant, characterized by its unique leaf and flower morphology. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat a range of health issues, including digestive problems, liver and kidney issues, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum dens-leonis subsp. officinale include its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include taraxasterol, triterpenoid saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
